summary: Code that fetches from a third party: a saved fixture is the required input, one parser per source, every outbound call through the SSRF guard with a timeout, and a captcha, empty page or network failure fails loudly.

required_inputs.name: source
required_inputs.description: The site, API or mailbox being read, and its terms if known

required_inputs.name: fixture
required_inputs.description: A saved HTML, JSON or Nuxt payload from the source, checked into the fixtures directory

required_inputs.name: existing_parser
required_inputs.description: The parser for this source if one exists, by path, or none after a grep

required_inputs.name: live_probe_authorization
required_inputs.description: For any live fetch during development: who authorized it and the row cap

checklist.rule: The parser is written and tested against the saved fixture; no live fetch is needed to run the tests
checklist.because: r3cruit3r collectors and War Room ingest both run offline unittest with HTML fixtures; a live-only test is skipped in CI and rots

checklist.rule: One parser per source; grep for an existing one before writing, and extend it
checklist.because: r3cruit3r had two GotSport parsers that disagreed on the same page; War Room discovery scripts duplicated selectors

checklist.rule: Every outbound fetch goes through the SSRF guard and carries a timeout; browser navigations too
checklist.because: r3cruit3r ssrf_guard is a sensitive path because a collector fetches URLs found on pages; a hung navigation held a worker for hours

checklist.rule: A captcha, an empty page, a changed layout or a network error raises; it never returns an empty list as success or as absence
checklist.because: War Room ingest AGENTS.md: network failure is not evidence that a sport does not exist; r3cruit3r captcha pages once imported as zero recruits

checklist.rule: Never guess or synthesize a value to make a record look complete; missing stays missing
checklist.because: War Room ingest: never guess an email address to make a record appear complete

checklist.rule: A reimport preserves human qualification and edits; the merge is field-level with provenance
checklist.because: War Room reimports must preserve human qualification; r3cruit3r merge surfaces keep the coach's decision

checklist.rule: A live probe is opt-in, labeled, capped by row count, and its counts are pasted; it never runs in the default test path
checklist.because: r3cruit3r test_travel_e2e_live is in the CI ignore list; War Room never runs ingest.run or --enrich in verification

checklist.rule: Never read or write the browser profile, cookies or credentials directory; keys only from the environment
checklist.because: War Room ingest/.browser-profile is deny-listed; the poster's session lives there

checklist.rule: The collector stays inside the source's declared scope (sport, region, entity type) and rejects rows outside it
checklist.because: War Room ingest is women's soccer only; out-of-scope rows polluted the CRM once

done_output: parser extended or created, with the duplicate grep result
SSRF guard and timeout lines quoted
the failure cases tested: captcha, empty, layout change, network error
live probe: none, or authorization, row cap and counts
stop_conditions: no fixture and no authorization to capture one
the task asks for a live fetch in the test path
the source's terms forbid automated access
the task asks to fill missing values

adapter_fields.name: fixtures_dir
adapter_fields.description: Where saved pages and payloads live

adapter_fields.name: ssrf_guard
adapter_fields.description: The guard every fetch goes through

adapter_fields.name: parser_registry
adapter_fields.description: Where parsers are listed or how to grep for one

adapter_fields.name: live_probe_flag
adapter_fields.description: How a live probe is opted into and capped

adapter_fields.name: source_scope
adapter_fields.description: The declared scope rows must fall inside
